description: Source code for the CertificateView class and related cryptographic functions in the quiche QUIC implementation, handling certificate parsing, validation, and signature verification.

classes.name: CertificateView
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing parsing, validation, and signature verification functionalities.

classes.name: CertificatePrivateKey
classes.description: Encapsulates a private key used for signing, supporting loading from DER or PEM formats, signing data, and key matching.

methods.name: PublicKeyTypeFromKey
methods.description: Determines the public key type from an EVP_PKEY object.

methods.name: PublicKeyTypeFromSignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Maps a signature algorithm identifier to a PublicKeyType.

methods.name: SupportedSignatureAlgorithmsForQuic
methods.description: Returns a list of supported signature algorithms for QUIC.

methods.name: PublicKeyTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a PublicKeyType enum to a human-readable string.

methods.name: CertificateView::ParseSingleCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate into a CertificateView object.

methods.name: CertificateView::public_key_type
methods.description: Returns the public key type of the certificate.

methods.name: CertificateView::ValidatePublicKeyParameters
methods.description: Validates the public key parameters according to security policies.

methods.name: CertificateView::VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature over data using the certificate's public key.

methods.name: CertificateView::GetHumanReadableSubject
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the certificate's subject.

methods.name: CertificatePrivateKey::LoadFromDer
methods.description: Loads a private key from DER-encoded data.

methods.name: CertificatePrivateKey::LoadPemFromStream
methods.description: Loads a private key from a PEM stream, supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: CertificatePrivateKey::Sign
methods.description: Signs data with the private key using a specified signature algorithm.

methods.name: CertificatePrivateKey::MatchesPublicKey
methods.description: Checks if the private key matches the public key in a certificate.

methods.name: CertificatePrivateKey::ValidForSignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Checks if the private key is valid for a given signature algorithm.
